notes.FIX_BONUS: Top players' FRA draft video (2026-11-02): 'always take the land unless it's so above replacement'. FRA top-drafter train top-1 55.76 -> 56.11, test 55.87 -> 56.33 (top-3 85.79 -> 86.58); mock decks 54.58 -> 54.54 (100 fresh tables); dual lands per draft 0.28 -> 0.97. Bonus 1-6 all similar; 3 is the middle.
notes.themes: Synergy hypotheses from FRA guides, recorded 2026-11-02 for testing (tools/fit_themes.py); not applied by the engine. Patterns match lower-cased oracle text.
notes.splash_claims: Guides on splashing, to check against fitted splash/three rules: slow decks (ramp, graveyard, control) splash, aggro does not (LLU #258); 3 sources minimum, 4 ideal, scale with real fixers, basics alone do not count (LLU #258); double-pip splashes work with 7-8 sources thanks to duals, landcyclers, Murmuring Volume (State of the Format; our deck_features showed -2.0 points per double-pip splash copy); splash order: single-pip raw power, then card advantage or removal to fill gaps, then to replace filler (LLU #258); RG ramp often ends 3-5 colours (State of the Format); Heartwood makes red the easiest splash for green.
notes.card_verdicts: Card verdicts in the ranking videos vs 17Lands All Decks GIH WR percentile (2026-11-02): bombs median 97th, 'shockingly strong' 80th, 'surprisingly weak' 9th, 'never draft' 10th, so card ratings already carry them. Disagreements: Sphinx's Approach 62nd (video: never; LLU #261: good filler, stats inflated by who plays it), Rise of the Deathbringer 51st (video: bomb). Video advice 'do not play two bad cards because they combo' (Ghalta + Living Library) matches the synergy tests: payoffs add little beyond card ratings.
notes.pick_rules_from_videos: Veveil: take a planeswalker dual over a replacement-level card ('you always get 23 spells'; ~50% of packs have one), as FRA's FIX_BONUS already does; two Rewrite Regrets ideal, Geist of Saint Thalia max 2, Unsummon 1-2; three colours after a black Garruk; pack 3 wheels are the oddest; skip extra removal when flush (5-6); two-bodied cards (Heartstring Puller) lower the creature count a removal-heavy deck needs. Tournament video: P1P1 Null Summoner partly because splashable; read the open lane (red) and pivot. Draft guide: UB needs cheap defence (Mabel, Bitter Recluse) to reach the late game; WB should lean aggressive.
